description: AUTOPILOT project partners publish two related urban-driving collections at Versailles, with coverage of complete car-sharing journeys and the automated-driving part only. Described tests compare cyclist/pedestrian encounters without connected devices and with a smartphone/watch or connected bicycle. Full journeys include booking, manual driving to an automated-driving section and return to the sharing station. Contents are described as CAN/GPS vehicle state, acceleration and environment detections, bicycle messages, oneM2M car-sharing status and captured cooperative-awareness messages. The two deposits have distinct file inventories, but possible overlap between full journeys and automated segments is not ruled out. They are grouped as components without summing them as independent trials. The related Versailles platooning collection serves fleet rebalancing, a distinct scenario. Metadata do not supply reproduced safety outcomes or complete sampling specifications. Zenodo provides the described files free under CC BY 4.0. Only descriptions and file descriptors were inspected; archives, values, code and media remain unread. File availability does not verify completeness, internal formats or measurement quality.
